data.transform:
(
  $item := $state.context.LOCAL.item;
  $assembly := $state.context.LOCAL.assembly;
  $component := $state.context.LOCAL.component;
  $facilities :=$state.context.LOCAL.strategyFacility.facility;

  $new := $leftAntiJoin( [$item], [$assembly.strategies.edges.node], 'rev_id', 'externalId');
  $old := $innerJoin( [$item], [$assembly.strategies.edges.node], 'rev_id', 'externalId', 'strategy', { 'grouped': false } );
  {
    "new":[$facilities#$i.($internalStrategyId:= $cuid();$internalProcessId:= $cuid();
    $new.(
      
    {
        "strategy": {
          "id": $internalStrategyId,
          "externalId": rev_id,
          "code":$assembly.name
            & "-"
            & bom.br_name
            & "-"
            & rev_id
            & "-LOC"
            & $facilities[$i].externalId,
          "name": $assembly.name
            & "-" 
            & bom.br_name
            & "-"
            & rev_id,
          "productId": $assembly.id,
          "productStrategyStageId":"Production UnApproved",
          "strategyTypeId": bom.i_isphantom="T" ? "Phantom" : "Assembly",
          "revision": bom.br_name,
          "primary":true,
          "active": bom.b_isinactive="F" and bom.br_isinactive="F" and bom.r_isinactive="F",
          "validated":false,
          "effectiveAt": $isNilOrEmpty(bom.br_effectivestartdate) 
            ? null 
            : $moment(bom_br.effectivestartdate),
          "expirationAt": $isNilOrEmpty(bom.br_effectiveenddate) 
            ? null 
            : $moment(bom.br_effectiveenddate),
          "unitTypeId": $string(bom.i_unitstype),
          "consumptionUnitId": $string(bom.i_consumptionunit),
          "purchaseUnitId": $string($coalesce([bom.i_purchaseunit, bom.i_stockunit])),
          "inventoryUnitId": $string(bom.i_stockunit),
          "saleUnitId": $string(bom.i_saleunit),
          "facilityId": $facilities[$i].id,
          "inventoryTypeId": bom.isfulfillable='T' ? "Finished Goods" : "WIP",
          "integrationData": $
        }, 
        "process": {
          /* "id": rev_id & (bom.i_isphantom="T" ? "-PHANTOM" : "-DEFAULT"), */
          "id": $internalProcessId,
          "externalId": rev_id & (bom.i_isphantom="T" ? "-PHANTOM" : "-DEFAULT"),
          "code": $assembly.name 
            & "-" 
            & rev_id
            & (bom.i_isphantom="T" ? "-PHANTOM" : "-DEFAULT"),
          "productStrategyId": $internalStrategyId,
          "order": "0",
          "setupRate": 0,
          "standardRate": 0,
          "cycleTime": 0,
          "processId": bom.i_isphantom="T" ? "PHANTOM" : "DEFAULT ASSEMBLY",
          "productionTypeId": "Production",
          "unitPerCycle":0,
          "idealRate":0,
          "quotedRate":0,
          "productionOperators":0,
          "setupOperators":0,
          "final":true
        },
        "bom": cmp.(
          $i := $string(c_item);
          $cmp := $component[externalId=$i];
          $charge := $cmp.productTypeId="OthCharge";
          {
            /* "id": %.rev_id & "-" & c_id, */
            "externalId": %.rev_id & "-" & c_id, 
            "standardUsage": c_quantity,
            "integrationData":$,
            "assemblyProductStrategyProcessId": $internalProcessId,
            "componentProductId": $cmp.id,
            "componentProductStrategyId": $charge ? null : $cmp.strategies.edges.node.id,
            "componentProductStrategyProcessId": $charge ? null : $cmp.strategies.edges.node.strategyProcesses.edges.node.id,
            "bomTypeId": $charge ? "Charge" : "Product",
            "consumptionModeId": "Standard"
          }
        )
      }))]
      ,
      "old":[$old.{
        "update": {
          "active": bom.b_isinactive="F" and bom.br_isinactive="F" and bom.r_isinactive="F",
          "effectiveAt": $isNilOrEmpty(bom.br_effectivestartdate) 
            ? null 
            : $moment(bom_br.effectivestartdate),
          "expirationAt": $isNilOrEmpty(bom.br_effectiveenddate) 
            ? null 
            : $moment(bom.br_effectiveenddate),
          "integrationData":$omit($,'strategy')
        },"where": {
          "id":strategy.id
        }
      }]
    }
  )
